sloka: ततो ऽथ बुद्ध्वा स तदस्त्रबन्धं प्रभोः प्रभावाद् विगतात्मवेगः ।पितामहानुग्रहमात्मनश्च विचिन्तयामास हरिप्रवीरः ।। ५.४८.४०।।।।
transliteration: tato 'tha buddhvā sa tadastrabandhaṁ prabhoḥ prabhāvād vigatātmavegaḥ ।pitāmahānugrahamātmanaśca vicintayāmāsa haripravīraḥ ।। 5.48.40।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman realised that it was by invoking creator Brahma and applying the mantra that he was caught by Brahmastram. On that occasion he started thinking of the boon given to him by Grandsire Brahma :
